iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 76. CRITICAL: Second round Islamabad talks imminent - US and Iran signal attendance per AP. But Iran state TV denies delegation has visited. Gap: US demands 20-yr enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 yrs. IAEA locked out 8+ months - cannot verify enrichment. IAEA DG Grossi urges "very detailed" verification. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. Arms Control Assoc: US negotiators ill-prepared. Experts: stockpile could yield up to 10 bombs. Probability 28%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 76. CRITICAL: Ceasefire expires TOMORROW Apr 22. Trump: "won't extend ceasefire" - military "LOCKED AND LOADED." Hormuz RE-CLOSED Apr 18 - IRGC fired on 3+ commercial vessels. Iran seized US-linked ship Apr 19. UN Sec-Gen Guterres: "most severe energy crisis in a generation." AP: US and Iran signal they'll attend new round of talks in Islamabad. But Iran state TV denies delegation has visited Islamabad. Oil prices extremely volatile. China says war at "critical stage of transition." Thousands of security personnel deployed in Islamabad. Probability 48%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 76. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire Day 5, mostly holding, expires Apr 26. Hezbollah not formal signatory - remains armed. Israel holds 10km buffer zone. Deal does NOT require Lebanon to disarm Hezbollah. In-principle extension agreement reported. 2,196 killed in Lebanon. Probability 14%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Turkey positioning as "strategic balance factor" in NATO. Hosting 2026 NATO Summit Jul 7-8 in Ankara. Pushing for larger role in European defense. Warning EU against excluding Turkey from defense mechanisms. Stable. Probability 3%.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: ELEVATED: Hormuz closure severely threatens India energy imports. IRGC fired on Indian-flagged tanker Sanmar Herald. CFR warns India-Pakistan conflict likely in 2026. Pakistan says China supports efforts to facilitate US-Iran talks. Probability 7%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 76. RISING: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting - would allow transport/possession of nuclear weapons on Finnish soil. First F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Russia reinforcing strategic/nuclear assets near Finnish border. Lavrov at Antalya Diplomatic Forum: NATO an "aggressive bloc." Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Grushko: Russia has "enough opportunities to respond." Probability 36%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: CRITICAL: US intelligence confirmed: China preparing MANPADS shipment to Iran - shoulder-fired missiles + radar. Chinese officials deny. Analysts: China may use Iran arms as Trump-Xi summit bargaining chip re Taiwan. NYT: Iran resistance offers uncomfortable lessons for China re Taiwan. US Pacific redeployment benefits China. China says war at "critical stage of transition" and calls for further negotiations. China also mediating Pakistan-Afghanistan talks. Probability 48%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 74. RISING: Launched 5 tactical ballistic missiles from Sinpo Apr 19 - 7th test of 2026, 4th in April. Kim "great satisfaction" over Hwasong-11 variant, precision at 136km. Japan strongly protested. Also tested cruise/anti-ship missiles from destroyer Choe Hyon. Bloomberg: Kim ramps up tests as US reportedly curbs intel to Seoul. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Probability 14%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1178+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded. ISW daily assessments. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - 40% export capacity disabled. Zelensky: Russia chose "Easter escalation" over ceasefire. Russia-Ukraine agree to Orthodox Easter truce. Pope Leo urges end to hostilities. Lavrov: patience "not unlimited." Probability 38%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: Open war continues. China-mediated Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues at lower intensity. Pakistan mortars killed Afghan civilians during talks. Pakistan operations against Taliban to continue. China actively mediating. NPR confirms new round of talks. Probability 5%. Stable.
